text:
Cassidy Park: hey team — day one here. my laptop arrived but the MDM enrol screen is asking for an enrollment code. i also need VPN + repo access. who do i ping? also low-stakes important question: favorite desk plant recs? :seedling:

Asha Mehta: welcome Cassidy!! :tada: for plants — snake plant or pothos are hard to kill. pls DM your pronouns and timezone so we can add you to the right calendars and buddy pairing slots.

Liam O'Connor: hi @Cassidy Park 94 i'm your onboarding buddy. i'll walk you through perms + quickstart. steps: enroll MDM, add SSH key (ed25519), join Okta MFA, then i'll run the devbox checklist with you. dm when ready for a 20m pair.

Cassidy Park: thanks Liam — quick q: should i generate the SSH key locally or use the portal?

Jin Park: generate locally. recommended command:
```
ssh-keygen -t ed25519 -C "cassidy@redwood"
```
then copy ~/.ssh/id_ed25519.pub into the dev portal under Access -> SSH Keys. ping me if the repo still denies.

Cassidy Park: on the MDM screen it literally says: "Enrollment code: required" 94 where is that coming from?

MDM-Bot: Hi Cassidy! Enrollment codes are issued by IT for first-time device enrollment. If you received a kit, check the sticky label. Otherwise request a one-time code from IT or @Jin Park can create one for you.

Jin Park: created a one-time code and sent via DM. let me know if it times out; i'll regenerate.

Evan Ng: for VPN use the "redwood-split" profile. docs: https://intranet.redwood/it/vpn. after MDM + Okta MFA the VPN cert should provision automatically.

Cassidy Park: got the DM, enrolled successfully, uploaded SSH pub key, and i can see the infra repo now. thanks all! excited to grab a little pothos for my desk :) :raised_hands:
